# anthropic_workspace (Data Source)

Looks up one workspace by id or name. Requires `admin_api_key` or `oauth_token`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_workspace" "by_id" {
  id = "wrkspc_01ExampleWorkspaceId000000"
}

data "anthropic_workspace" "by_name" {
  name = "Production"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) Workspace id. Exactly one of `id` or `name` must be set.
- `name` (String) Workspace name (must be unique among live workspaces).

### Read-Only

- `allowed_inference_geos` (List of String) Allowed inference geographies; null when unrestricted.
- `archived_at` (String) Archive timestamp; null while live.
- `compartment_id` (String) Encryption compartment id.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `default_inference_geo` (String) Default inference geography.
- `display_color` (String) Hex color.
- `external_key_id` (String) Attached customer-managed encryption key id, if any.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags.
- `workspace_geo` (String) Workspace data geography.
